messages.content: Predict the actual human response in an anonymous online experiment with US adults. The computer assigns fixed leader and recipient roles. Only leaders complete a 120-second arithmetic task; each correct answer produces 2 community tokens. The leader divides the entire community pool between self and recipient. A private subsidy, when currently present, gives the leader one additional private token per correct answer; private tokens cannot be transferred. Each token allocated to the recipient is multiplied by the stated factor; tokens kept by the leader are not multiplied. One token pays one US cent, with a separate $3 show-up fee. You are the leader and have just completed the effort task. Choose the division of the current community pool; the private amount is yours regardless of this division. Any division of community tokens is permitted by the written instructions. Output only JSON with leader_community_tokens and recipient_allocated_community_tokens, nonnegative amounts summing to the current pool. The recipient entry is before multiplication. Predict the recorded response without advice or explanations.
